Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: After the Planner provided new, targeted queries and asked for authoritative sources, WebSurfer ignored those instructions and repeatedly reran the same general search, relying on DuckDuckGo’s auto-generated snippets instead of opening credible sources (USGS/UNL/etc.). This stalled progress and prevented delivering the straightforward correct answer (Ogallala Aquifer).
